releases.notes:
![Fixes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccab62feebd72ed74e3fa24e7e67cc661caab448.png)
- **Refixed Challenge Plush damage breaking armor.**
- **Fixed Challenge Plush not being given out when EngiePoc is enabled.**
- **Fixed a crash that would happen because of the Challenge Plushes item information.**
- **Fixed being unable to upgrade Hostile Engie tools to Doomsday tools in smithing tables.**
- **Fixed being unable to upgrade Antimatter Hostile Engie tools to Antimatter Doomsday tools in smithing tables.**

![Reminder!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/128832adf5e69b4e39b5e2bf6594206cc5e4fb4e.png)
- **IF YOU FIND ISSUES, PLEASE REPORT THEM ON THE [GITHUB](https://github.com/DevEngieGames/EngiesChaos-and-EngieLib)! https://github.com/DevEngieGames/EngiesChaos-and-EngieLib**
